import json,http.client,pathlib,subprocess,sys
sha="c579553014dfc30e0c6ac765f4ab9d9527210497"
def check(name,ok):
 print(name+"="+("PASS" if ok else "FAIL"),flush=True)
 if not ok:sys.exit(42)
token=(pathlib.Path.home()/".config"/"tgtumbler"/"tumblr-operation-app"/"tumblr-app-access-token").read_text().strip()
def get(path,authed=True):
 c=http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1",8081,timeout=8)
 try:
  c.request("GET",path,headers={"Authorization":"Bearer "+token} if authed else {})
  r=c.getresponse();return r.status,r.read(250000)
 finally:c.close()
head=subprocess.run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=8).stdout.strip()
check("CHECKOUT_SHA",head==sha)
s,b=get("/healthz",False)
check("LIVE_SHA",s==200 and json.loads(b).get("commit")==sha)
s,b=get("/drafts?offset=0&limit=100")
check("OWNER_DRAFT_PAGING",s==200 and isinstance(json.loads(b).get("total"),int) and isinstance(json.loads(b).get("drafts"),list))
s,b=get("/media/jobs?offset=0&limit=100")
check("OWNER_MEDIA_HISTORY",s==200 and isinstance(json.loads(b),dict))
s,b=get("/library")
check("OWNER_LIBRARY",s==200 and isinstance(json.loads(b),dict))
s,b=get("/drafts?offset=0&limit=100",False)
check("OWNER_ACCESS_CONTROL",s==401)
s,b=get("/app.js")
check("PERSISTENT_DRAFT_UI",s==200 and b'draftOffset' in b and b'has_next' in b)
for test in ("test_drafts.py","test_assistant.py","test_library.py","test_media_save.py","test_operation_app.py"):
 result=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-B","-m","unittest","discover","-s","tests","-p",test,"-q"],capture_output=True,timeout=45)
 check("GSERVER_TEST_"+test,result.returncode==0)
print("EXTERNAL_PROVIDER_CALLS=ZERO")
print("ACCEPTANCE=PASS")
PY
